description:
New Orleans Saints at Detroit Lions
The Detroit Lions host the New Orleans Saints in Week 1 NFL action at Ford Field in Detroit. The Lions finished the previous season with a 9-8 record, anchored by Aidan Hutchinson's 14.5 sacks. The Saints finished last season with a 6-11 record.

title: NFL Football
description:
Washington Commanders at Philadelphia Eagles
The Eagles host the Commanders in Week 1 NFL action at Lincoln Financial Field. The Eagles enter this matchup after splitting their 2025 head-to-head series 1-1. The Eagles finished last season with an 11-6 record, while the Commanders finished 5-12.
